notes: Provider records are added by the part that audits each provider (so far: claude-cli and the non-picker opencode external block). legacyModelAliases keys match whole stored ids only (providers.ts parseModelSelection looks up the text after the provider prefix, effort suffix included), so every alias added later must list each @effort and +fast variant it keeps resolving.

copilot.defaultAuthPath: GitHub account VS Code is signed into (Copilot host, models come from the VS Code LM API)

kiro-cli.defaultAuthPath: Kiro login plus KIRO_API_KEY for headless runs

opencode-cli.defaultAuthPath: OpenCode Zen key for opencode/* models, OpenCode Go subscription for opencode-go/* models

kimi-cli.defaultAuthPath: Moonshot AI / Kimi Code OAuth device-code sign-in (`kimi login`)

devpass-cli.defaultAuthPath: LLM Gateway DevPass credential (`devpass-code providers login`)

evidence.authContext: Claude Code subscription login; live `claude --model <id> -p ok --output-format json` probes run on the Ensemble dev box (aarch64 container), reading the resolved id from the response's modelUsage key; credential class and account tier for that box were not captured alongside the probe output (see the Capture log's caveat in audit-2026-09.md) and still need recording
evidence.source: `claude --model <id> -p ok --output-format json` for each id below, plus `claude --help` (fable alias = latest model); see the Capture log section of audit-2026-09.md for the full table

records.notes: Live CLI probes ran this round for claude-fable-5-1, claude-fable-5, fable, opus, sonnet and haiku (all exit 0); see the Capture log section in audit-2026-09.md. Whether opus/sonnet/haiku float to a newer pin was not established by a single resolution, so their `(latest)` relabel was not applied.

entries.source: `claude --model claude-fable-5-1 -p ok --output-format json`: exit 0, resolved to itself (modelUsage: claude-fable-5-1); also the Anthropic model list in the Claude Code session environment
`claude --model claude-fable-5 -p ok --output-format json`: exit 0, resolved to itself (modelUsage: claude-fable-5), so it is not an alias and is selectable on the default path

`claude --model fable -p ok --output-format json`: exit 0, resolved to claude-fable-5-1 (modelUsage), confirming `fable` floats to 5.1; also `claude --help` (claude 2.1.274) describes fable as the alias for the latest model
entries.note: Label changed from `Fable 5` to `Fable (latest)`: the alias already resolves to 5.1, and an unversioned label cannot go stale. The id is unchanged so stored selections keep resolving.

entries.source: `claude --model sonnet -p ok --output-format json`: exit 0, resolved to claude-sonnet-5 (modelUsage); alias floating not established by a single resolution
`claude --model opus -p ok --output-format json`: exit 0, resolved to claude-opus-5 (modelUsage); alias floating not established by a single resolution

`claude --model haiku -p ok --output-format json`: exit 0, resolved to the dated id claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (modelUsage), unlike the other three which resolve to undated ids; alias floating not established by a single resolution

records.reason: github-copilot/* and openai/* ids are kept in the seeded opencode catalog only so saved external-provider selections keep resolving; the picker offers just the explicit Zen (opencode/*) and Go (opencode-go/*) tiers, so nothing here is user-selectable and it is outside the audit.
